capabilities: Set colors on files and folders via the context menu
Add custom colors to a palette in settings
Cascade folder colors to child files
Color the background instead of the text
extras: README notes Folder Note's file underlines are not colored unless a CSS snippet is added.
problem: Obsidian's file tree offers no way to visually distinguish files and folders with colors.

relations.evidence: Folder Note - Will also work out of the box

summary: File explorer plugin that lets you assign custom colors to individual files and folders in the file tree.
